# ColorPicker { #anylumino.ColorPicker }

```python
ColorPicker(
    value='black',
    description='',
    concise=False,
    disabled=False,
    **kwargs,
)
```

Color picker control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type     | Description                                    | Default   |
|-------------|----------|------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| value       | optional | Initial value and synced Python value.         | `'black'` |
| description | optional | Label shown above the control.                 | `''`      |
| concise     | optional | Whether to use a compact color-picker display. | `False`   |
| disabled    | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled.          | `False`   |
